definitions.gloss: narrow path; narrow road; narrow lane
definitions.explanation: A path or road that is narrow. Can refer to physical narrow paths in nature or between buildings, as well as appearing in literary and cultural contexts.

examples.japanese: {細道|ほそみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: To walk along a narrow path.
To pass through the narrow lane between houses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細道|ほそみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどっていく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Following the narrow path through the mountains, a small shrine came into view.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{細|ほそ}い→細い：02962_hosoi⟧ (narrow/thin) + ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (path/road).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {細道|ほそみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to go through a narrow path
- {細道|ほそみち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧: to pass through a narrow lane
- {細道|ほそみち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a narrow path

CULTURAL NOTE:
Famously appears in the title of Matsuo Basho's travel journal ⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{細道|ほそみち} (The Narrow Road to the Interior, 1689), one of the most celebrated works of Japanese literature.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{小道|こみち}→小道：21202_komichi⟧: small path — a diminutive, charming path; more literary
- ⟦{路地|ろじ}→路地：06501_roji⟧: alley, back lane — typically an urban narrow passage between buildings
- ⟦{裏道|うらみち}→裏道：19428_uramichi⟧: back road — a road behind main streets, used as a shortcut
